about.heroSubtitle: Industrial-Luxury Container Caffe — 5 unique zones in Sa Dec
about.storyLead: AURA CAFE was born from the idea of combining industrial container architecture with premium coffee experiences.
about.card1Desc: 5 unique container zones: Jade Counter, Sky Deck, Noir Cabin, Aura Lounge, VIP Steel Nest. Each area has its own distinct style.
about.card2Desc: Order by QR code — no app needed, no waiting. Scan, choose, and pay with convenience.
about.card3Desc: From quality coffee to luxurious spaces, every detail is crafted for the best experience.
about.phase1Desc: The idea of a container cafe combining industrial architecture and professional brewing was born.
about.phase2Desc: 5 container spaces designed and built at 39 Nguyen Tat Thanh, Sa Dec.
about.phase3Desc: AURA CAFE officially opened its doors with a unique industrial-luxury space.
about.phase4Desc: QR ordering system, online payments, and comprehensive digital management implemented.
about.phase5Desc: 30+ management features and a complete digital ecosystem for a modern coffee experience.
about.value1Desc: Selected coffee beans, professional roasting process, every cup is a work of art.
about.value2Desc: 5 different spaces for work, dates, and relaxation — each with its own inspiration.
about.value3Desc: QR ordering, digital payments, smart management — leading F&B technology.
about.zone1Desc: Green quartz bar — social and mixing space
about.zone2Desc: Airy rooftop — sky view and open atmosphere
about.zone3Desc: Minimalist cabin — private, quiet for work & dates
about.zone4Desc: Silver-toned lounge — relax with warm chrome lighting
about.zone5Desc: Premium space — dark steel private room
about.spacesDesc: Five zones, five distinct personalities — every corner at AURA CAFE offers a unique experience.
about.grandOpeningAlt: AURA CAFE grand opening at 39 Nguyễn Tất Thành

landing.orderNowAria: Order now via online ordering system
landing.heroDescription: A premium container coffee experience in an elegant industrial space. Where light and shadow blend into a unique architectural symphony.
landing.featureMenuDesc: From hand-selected Arabica beans to specialty tea blends, crafted by the most dedicated barista artisans.
landing.featureReserveDesc: Secure your ideal seat in our luxurious lounge space for important meetings or relaxing moments.
landing.featureDeliveryDesc: Enjoy AURA flavors at home or office with our fast delivery service throughout Sa Dec area.
landing.galleryDescription: Aura Cafe is more than just a coffee shop; it is a lifestyle statement. We transform raw shipping containers into artistic spaces with premium materials, intelligent lighting, and the soul of aesthetes.
landing.galleryMainAlt: Interior of the luxury container cafe at night with warm amber lighting and industrial design
landing.galleryInsetAlt: Close-up of a perfectly crafted latte with intricate leaf art
landing.galleryBullet1Desc: A fusion of stainless steel, frosted tempered glass, and natural oak wood.
landing.galleryBullet2Desc: Lighting system designed by experts, optimized for evening experiences.

storyNew.heroImageAlt: Aura Cafe nocturnal interior with bronze lighting
storyNew.storyLead: Aura Cafe is more than a destination; it's a structural dialogue between raw industrial resilience and the ephemeral beauty of the perfect roast.
storyNew.descArchitecture: Our foundation is built from decommissioned cargo containers, re-engineered as minimalist glass-walled sanctuaries. We embrace the industrial scars of the steel, celebrating its history while housing the future of hospitality.
storyNew.imgArchitectureAlt: Close up architectural detail of weathered container corner meeting chrome glass frame
storyNew.descBrewing: We view extraction as an engineering challenge. Utilizing custom-modded pressure profiles and laboratory-grade filtration, every pour is a repeatable masterpiece of flavor chemistry.
storyNew.descSanctuary: Designed for the night owls, the thinkers, and the quiet creators. Our lighting is calibrated to the golden hour, creating a focus-enhancing void in the heart of the city.
storyNew.phase01Desc: Initial visioning of a cafe that exists at the intersection of container architecture and technical brewing precision.
storyNew.phase02Desc: Salvaging three high-cube containers and re-engineering them with reinforced frames and panoramic glass panels.
storyNew.phase03Desc: Aura Cafe opens its doors, establishing a new standard for the nocturnal coffee experience in the city center.
storyNew.value1Desc: Zero compromise on origin. We source only single-estate beans that meet our rigorous chemical profile standards.
storyNew.value2Desc: Transparency in every gear. Our brewing process is fully visible, inviting curiosity and conversation.
storyNew.value3Desc: Engineered for longevity. From container re-use to zero-waste filtration, we respect the machine that is our planet.
storyNew.teamDesc: Our team consists of industrial designers, chemical engineers, and master roasters united by a singular focus.
storyNew.ctaDesc: Experience the convergence of architectural design and the world's most precise caffeine delivery system.
storyNew.footerTagline: Where industrial design meets the art of coffee.

eventsNew2.mixologyDesc: Uncover the secrets behind our signature nocturnal infusions with our lead mixologist.
eventsNew2.mixologyImageAlt: A macro shot of a sophisticated cocktail being prepared in a dark, high-end industrial bar with vapor rising from dry ice
eventsNew2.degustationDesc: A curated 7-course culinary journey inspired by raw industrial elements and rare botanicals.
eventsNew2.degustationImageAlt: An artistic high-angle shot of a long dining table set for an exclusive tasting menu in a high-ceilinged industrial loft
eventsNew2.digitalArtDesc: A sensory immersion combining generative digital art with experimental electronic soundscapes.
eventsNew2.digitalArtImageAlt: A low-light scene inside a private art gallery space during a nocturnal exhibition with glowing digital art
eventsNew2.vinylImageAlt: A blurred background of a dark vinyl listening room with warm wood textures and vintage speaker cabinets
eventsNew2.velvetImageAlt: A dark and moody image of velvet curtains in a private theater setting
eventsNew2.cyberLoungeImageAlt: An abstract close-up of dark metallic textures and glowing blue light lines

containerNew1.heroAriaLabel: Hero section — AURA CAFE container cafe
containerNew1.heroDescription: Experience the fusion of industrial container architecture and premium coffee culture in the heart of Sa Dec.
containerNew1.heroImageAlt: AURA CAFE interior with warm amber lighting
containerNew1.featureCardText: Raw industrial shipping containers transformed into luminous social spaces. Every corner tells a story of precision design.
containerNew1.featureImageAlt: Container architecture detail with glass panels and steel
containerNew1.frostedGlassDesc: Translucent partitions create intimate zones while maintaining an open, airy atmosphere.
containerNew1.chromeBronzeDesc: Warm metallic accents against cool steel — the signature palette of our nocturnal lounge.
containerNew1.loungeDescription: As the sun sets, our lounge transforms into a sanctuary of amber light, curated sounds, and handcrafted beverages.
containerNew1.loungeImageAlt: Nocturnal lounge interior with warm lighting
containerNew1.soundscapesDesc: Curated playlists and live acoustic sets that evolve with the evening mood.
containerNew1.artisanalBrewsDesc: Small-batch roasts and signature blends available exclusively after dark.
containerNew1.midnightColdDesc: 24-hour steeped cold brew with nitrogen infusion
containerNew1.chromeVelvetDesc: Matcha latte with silver leaf and oat milk

containerNew2.heroAriaLabel: Hero section — AURA CAFE premium experience
containerNew2.heroDescription: Discover a space where architectural precision meets the art of specialty coffee. Every detail is designed for the discerning palate.
containerNew2.feature1Desc: Every container is re-engineered with reinforced frames and panoramic glass, creating a dialogue between industrial heritage and modern luxury.
containerNew2.feature2Desc: Our extraction process is a science. Custom pressure profiles and lab-grade filtration ensure every pour is a masterpiece.
containerNew2.feature3Desc: Calibrated golden-hour lighting transforms our space into a focus-enhancing sanctuary as the city winds down.
containerNew2.atmosphereQuote: In the quiet hours between dusk and dawn, the container walls seem to breathe. Light refracts through frosted glass, casting geometric shadows that dance with the steam rising from your cup.
